title: Lipschitz graph corollary (Simon 5.2.7)
statement: For n >= 1, l, p > n there is beta in (0,1/4] (depending on n,l,p) such that for all L in (0,1], K >= 0, open U, V with generalized mean curvature H, delta, rho with 0 < delta <= (beta L)^(2n+2) and AllardHypotheses H p delta rho, every linear isometry q with dist(x, T_0) <= K delta^(1/(2n+2)) delta rho on spt V cap B_{2 delta rho}(0) (T_0 := q(R^n x {0})) and with E(xi, sigma, T_0) <= beta^2 L^2 for all xi in spt V cap B_{delta rho/2}(0), sigma in (0, delta rho/2], there is f: R^n -> R^l, L-Lipschitz on B^n_{delta rho/4}(0), with |f| <= K delta^(1/(2n+2)) delta rho there and spt V cap B_{delta rho/4}(0) = q(graph f over B^n_{delta rho/4}(0)) cap B_{delta rho/4}(0).
